standard_prerequisites.name: Recurring matrices and the quadratic form attached to them
standard_prerequisites.statement: A matrix whose off-diagonal entries are nonnegative together with a positive vector in its kernel, with no proper nonempty subset of indices that fails to interact with its complement, is what the chapter calls a symmetric recurring matrix; the quadratic form of such a matrix is written with a transposed vector on the left, and the surrounding lemmas of the same chapter use the recurrence hypothesis to control the kernel and the rank. The author's own hypotheses are retained inside the counted statement.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the semidefiniteness statement that the neighbouring lemmas of the chapter invoke when they compute the rank of a recurring matrix and the kernel of the matrices attached to a numerical type.

core_obligations: Normalise the weight vector: replace each entry a of subscript i j by a of subscript i j times m of subscript i times m of subscript j, which preserves the two hypotheses and the conclusion, so that the vector m may be taken to be the all-ones vector; the second hypothesis then reads that minus the diagonal entry equals the sum of the off-diagonal entries of the row (source line 388).

Expand the sum of minus a of subscript i j times the square of the difference of the two coordinates over all ordered pairs of distinct indices and regroup the terms, using the recurrence to replace the diagonal entries, to obtain twice the quadratic form (source lines 389-397).

Read off the sign: the regrouped expression is a sum of nonpositive terms, so the quadratic form is at most zero; if equality holds, then the set of indices whose coordinate differs from the first coordinate interacts with nothing outside itself, so by the second hypothesis it is the whole index set and the vector is a multiple of the all-ones vector (source lines 398-405).

proof_roadmap.step: Rescale the entries by the weights so that the weight vector is the all-ones vector and the diagonal is the negative row sum.
Regroup the sum of squared differences of coordinates into twice the quadratic form.
Deduce the sign and, in the equality case, use the second hypothesis to identify the kernel with the line spanned by the weight vector.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-recurring-symmetric-real（源 372-385 行，证明 387-405 行）：设 A 为对称实矩阵、非对角元非负，m 为正向量且在 A 的核中，且不存在与补集无耦合的真非空指标集，则二次型 x^tAx ≤ 0，等号当且仅当 x 是 m 的倍数。关键操作不是例行核验：先按权重缩放把 m 归一化、把假设 (1) 化成「对角元等于该行非对角元之和」（388 行），再把 Σ_{i≠j} −a_ij (x_j−x_i)^2 展开重组为 2x^tAx（389-397 行），最后从「每一项非正」得到半负定，并在等号情形用假设 (2) 证明指标集必须是全集、从而核恰为 m 张成的一维空间（398-405 行）。难点在于把矩阵的核（代数条件）翻译成图的连通性（组合条件）并同时得到等号刻画；原文位置在证明的 388、389-397、398-405 行。
